Nelco Invests $20 Million in Satellite Connectivity Firm Elveo

Tata Group's Nelco has acquired a minority stake in Elveo, a company focused on next-generation satellite connectivity. The investment amounts to $20 million. Elveo is involved in developing advanced satellite communication solutions. This move by Nelco aims to bolster its presence in the evolving satellite technology sector.
